# Influencer Orbit

> Influencer Orbit is a creator seeding agency for DTC skincare, cosmetics and beauty brands. Founded by Tayyab Habib, it runs confirm-first gifted product seeding, UGC with usage rights for ads, paid creator collabs and Spark Ads setup on Instagram, TikTok and YouTube. A 4-person remote team has run 2,000+ creator collaborations (2,483 posts live for one brand since January 2024) and coordinates 200+ product shipments a month, with clients across the US, UK and EU and creators across the US, Southeast Asia, the UK, Australia and the UAE. Its confirm-first method gets 70%+ of gifted creators to post, against 30% to 50% for typical cold gifting.

## Key facts
- What: done-for-you creator seeding (gifted product seeding, UGC with usage rights for ads, paid creator collabs, Spark Ads and whitelisting setup)
- Who for: DTC skincare, cosmetics and beauty brands, from brands new to seeding to brands running 100+ creator posts a month in-house
- Platforms: Instagram, TikTok, YouTube
- Founder: Tayyab Habib (https://www.linkedin.com/in/tayyab-habib-418a20220/)
- Team: 4 people, fully remote, operating since 2023
- Proof: 2,000+ creator collaborations, 1,000+ creators in network, 100+ brands served, 200+ product shipments a month, clients across the US, UK and EU
- Creators: sourced worldwide for US brands, mostly in the US, Southeast Asia, the UK, Australia and the UAE
- Post rate: 70%+ of confirmed creators post, against 30% to 50% for typical cold gifting (HypeAuditor)
- Case study: Esther Formula (Korean skincare and supplement brand), client since January 2024 (35 months), 50 to 200 creator posts a month (2,483 posts live in total), no in-house influencer manager hired
- Contact: tayyab@influencerorbit.com

## Offer
Plans start from $499 a month. Exact pricing is quoted on a 20-minute walkthrough.
- Liftoff: 12 guaranteed creator posts a month, 4 UGC assets with usage rights for ads, top 2 posts flagged, with spark ads codes, kickoff call, monthly summary. Best for: Brands new to influencer seeding
- Orbit: 50 guaranteed creator posts a month, 15 UGC assets with usage rights for ads, top 5 posts, spark ads codes secured and set up, monthly strategy call, monthly report with top creators. Best for: Growing DTC brands doing $500K to $3M a year
- Galaxy: 100+ guaranteed creator posts a month, 30+ UGC assets with usage rights for ads, top 10 posts, codes plus whitelisting on tiktok and meta, strategy call every two weeks, creator-level results every two weeks. Best for: Brands at $3M+ a year, or running seeding in-house
- Mission Control: 150+ guaranteed creator posts a month, 45+ UGC assets with usage rights for ads, every strong post, run as a continuous ad pipeline, weekly call with a dedicated lead, custom dashboard. Best for: Brands that need 150+ posts a month or several markets
- Every plan starts with a 60-day pilot, then runs month to month. Prepaying 3 months saves 10%.
- Guarantees: first creator posts live within 21 days; the plan's monthly post count is hit by day 60 (counted from when the brand ships product), or the team keeps working at no charge until it is
- The brand ships gifted product from its own warehouse, pays its own Spark Ads spend, and pays creators directly on paid collabs
- Add-ons: paid creator collab management, extra creator posts, extra ugc assets
- Method: confirm-first seeding. No creator receives product until they confirm.
